title: [Peek] Add preview support for EML and MSG email files

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The repaired candidate restore exited successfully; ten managed asset files, 56 managed package hashes and both native package payloads were verified. Restore logs were lost during launcher post-processing, so restore warnings and log-based scope remain unverified. The subsequent baseline Peek.FilePreviewer build exited zero, reported Build succeeded and covered all fifteen expected projects, with no warning or fatal markers found in its durable log. Baseline assembly and adjacent dependency-file hashes were retained. A TargetPath parsing bug then stopped candidate dispatch; the candidate build did not run. The exclusive lock was released after the baseline child exited and was not reacquired for post-processing. Paired validation remains incomplete; the next step is parser repair followed by a newly assigned candidate-only build, without repeating the baseline.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
